title: Identifying Intelligent Processes via Online Sequential Testing
abstract: arXiv:2609.26193v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Active sequential hypothesis testing studies how to identify an unknown hypothesis with a given set of sensing actions. We study this in the setting of identifying large language models (LLMs), \textit{i.e.}, if a user is conversing with an LLM drawn from a known set of models, how can they identify which one is in use? Here, the available sensing actions (evaluations) are themselves a design choice: an evaluator must first decide which environments and prompt families to construct, and only then decide how to use them sequentially. We formalize these two levels as an outer probe-design problem and an inner identification problem. Simply put, the outer stage selects a set of probes to be sent to the entire set of models, creating a kind of fingerprint dataset. translated_title: 通过在线序贯测试识别智能过程
translated_abstract: 主动序贯假设检验研究如何在给定一组感知动作的条件下识别未知假设。我们研究这一问题在大语言模型（LLM）识别场景中的应用，即：如果用户正在与来自某个已知模型集合中的一个LLM对话，如何识别出当前使用的具体是哪一个模型？在这里，可用的感知动作（即评估手段）本身就是一种设计选择：评估者必须首先决定构建哪些环境和提示词族，然后才能决定如何顺序地使用它们。我们将这两个层次形式化为外层探针设计问题和内层识别问题。简而言之，外层阶段选择一组探针发送给整个模型集合，从而创建一种指纹数据集；随后是内层阶段，它以最小化预算的方式顺序发送这组探针的子集，以识别正在使用的模型。对于外层问题，我们证明了选择……
tldr: 该论文将识别对话中所用大语言模型的问题形式化为“外层探针设计+内层序贯识别”的两层框架：先向所有候选模型发送探针构建指纹数据集，再以最小预算顺序选择探针来高效识别当前使用的模型。
en_tdlr: This paper formalizes identifying which LLM a user is conversing with as a two-level problem—an outer probe-design stage that builds a fingerprint dataset by probing all candidate models, followed by an inner sequential identification stage that sends a budget-minimizing subset of probes to pinpoint the model in use.
